purpose: The action row at the bottom of a Popover: status text at the start and its buttons at the end, or full-width buttons stacked. Its size follows the Popover.

notFor.case: Not for standalone use: it is the footer part of a Popover.
Actions at the bottom of a Modal or a Sheet.
Actions at the bottom of a dropdown menu.

Default.meaning: At rest; it has no interactive state of its own.
Default.visual: Top hairline in Border/subtle (Stroke/divider); leading status text in Content/secondary (Type/caption); the buttons keep their own roles.

a11y.role: None of its own: a region inside the Popover's non-modal dialog (Radix Popover).
a11y.keyboard: No keys of its own. Tab moves through its buttons inside the open Popover; Escape closes the Popover and returns focus to the trigger.
notes: The leading text is plain copy; the buttons keep their own focus order.

openQuestions: Stacked order: Figma puts skip above next, the reverse of the Modal (popover-contract.md). Is the difference intended, and which action is the primary one?
